description: Partially update split DNS configuration. Merges the provided domains with the existing config -- only the specified domains are changed, others are untouched. To remove a domain, set it to null: that is the idiom the API reference documents. An empty array is also accepted and forwarded as-is -- it is what Tailscale's Terraform provider sends.

splitDns.description: Map of domain to nameserver list to merge, or to null to remove that domain (e.g. { "new.example.com": ["10.0.0.3"], "old.example.com": null }). Only specified domains are changed.

name: tailscale_update_split_dns
title: Update split DNS (partial)
